items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions George Youngdahl as part of a historical account of the band 'The Four' in 1925, but the interviewee (Paul L. Howard) does not claim a personal relationship or interaction with him in the provided text.

ctx.x: January 1938 that was (inaudible) and a "Tempo" magazine decided to stay. The Four was very successful and soon begin to add men. Thomas Valentine on banjo and George Youngdahl, now Orendorff with Les Hite and Al Westlight on trumpets, were the first in 1925 for a job at Lyman's Alabam.
